Research position overview

This RMIT industry-linked project examines how silicon recovered from end-of-life solar panels can be processed into aluminium-based alloys. It connects materials research with photovoltaic waste recovery and the development of useful products from recycled resources.

Research Areas

  • Materials science
  • Recycling
  • Photovoltaic waste
